title: nf-core/pathogenepidemiology pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input. Only the columns required to import and route the reads are declared; any additional columns in the samplesheet (e.g. ENA metadata appended by nf-core/fetchngs) are ignored with a warning.

run_accession.errorMessage: Run accession (e.g. ERR123456) must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

library_strategy.errorMessage: library_strategy must be provided (e.g. WGS, AMPLICON)

instrument_platform.errorMessage: instrument_platform must be provided (e.g. ILLUMINA, OXFORD_NANOPORE, DNBSEQ)
